messages:
maria: quick q — for per-route bursts, we're planning to add X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket + X-Redwood-Burst-Remaining. Is that OK for client consumption? Also what should the 429 body look like?
kevin: +1 on headers but prefer standard names if possible. maybe keep X-RateLimit-* for compatibility? :thinking:
eli: we should definitely include a reset window (seconds) so clients can back off: e.g. X-RateLimit-Reset or Retry-After.
sre-bot: deploy queued: rate-limiter-v2 -> staging at 06:30 UTC (sha: b3f7a2a)
maria: here's a small header example i'm going to propose:
```
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit: 300
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset: 12
X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket: chat-completions
X-Redwood-Burst-Tokens: 25
Retry-After: 12
```
sam: for backward compat we should keep standard Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Remaining — many clients only read those. :+1:
jenn: suggested 429 body: {"error":"quota_exceeded","retry_after":12,"bucket":"chat-completions","type":"per_route"} — small, machine-friendly.
kevin: agree on body. also thought: include an advisory header when burst is almost gone so SDKs can proactively switch strategies: X-Redwood-Burst-Warning: 10%
maria: good call. i'll add a short section in the API contract about 'burst advisory' and note it's optional for older clients.
kevin: can we also define server behavior on overlapping quotas? e.g., per-route + global should return the most constraining 429 and headers from that namespace.
eli: yes — define deterministic precedence: per-route -> project -> global. include that in the contract.
maria: ok i'll draft the PR with: header examples, 429 body, precedence table, and a fallback guidance paragraph. pinging @kevin and @jenn for reviews. :eyes:
jenN: (typo) jenn: small nit — include a sample curl response in the docs so integrators can copy/paste.
sam: add an e2e test: simulate 500 concurrent small requests, assert 429 + headers present and body fields match. i'll own the test.
eli: adding the task to the sprint board now.
maria: perfect — thanks all. i'll drop the PR link here once it's up and note the rollout: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with canary monitors for increased 429s. :rocket:
kevin: will check the PR tomorrow morning. lmk if you want me to pair on the precedence table.
maria: appreciated. that should cover it for now.
